name: ListTrafficMirrorFilters

parameters.help_en: The name of the traffic mirror filter
parameters.help_zh: 流量镜像筛选条件的名称
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_name

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return in this request.

Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh:
本次查询的最大记录条数。

取值范围：**1**~**100**。默认值：**10**
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of traffic mirror filters. The maximum value of **N** is **100**, which means that you can query up to 100 traffic mirror filters at a time
parameters.help_zh: 流量镜像筛选条件的实例ID。其中**N**最大取值为**100**，即一次支持查询最多100条筛选条件
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_ids

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the traffic mirror filter.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list. For more information about regions that support traffic mirroring, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.help_zh:
流量镜像的所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。关于流量镜像支持的地域，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the traffic mirroring filter belongs
parameters.help_zh: 流量镜像所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value
